caseStudies.title: Meeting-room support ownership
caseStudies.challenge: Users faced inconsistent meeting-room performance because audio, display, connectivity and conferencing issues were handled separately.
caseStudies.solution: GPSPL structured AMC around the complete room environment, including preventive checks, source testing, audio review and user workflow validation.
caseStudies.implementation: The system was audited, common failure points were documented and periodic checks were aligned with the client's operating schedule.
caseStudies.results: The client gained clearer ownership, faster issue diagnosis and more predictable meeting-room readiness.

caseStudies.title: LED wall preventive maintenance
caseStudies.challenge: A high-visibility display was used frequently and needed ongoing assurance beyond installation.
caseStudies.solution: GPSPL aligned preventive inspection, controller review, visual checks, warranty coordination and service-reporting workflow.
caseStudies.implementation: The display system was checked for visual consistency, source workflow, operational readiness and support documentation.
caseStudies.results: The site had a defined maintenance process and clearer escalation path for future issues.

caseStudies.title: Pan-India technology support
caseStudies.challenge: A buyer needed support consistency across multiple sites with different AV and IT equipment mixes.
caseStudies.solution: GPSPL mapped systems by location, defined AMC scope, response expectations and reporting format.
caseStudies.implementation: Support workflow was structured around service tickets, preventive visits and escalation coordination.
caseStudies.results: The organization gained a scalable support model for distributed enterprise technology assets.

faqs.question: Which systems can GPSPL cover under AMC?
faqs.answer: GPSPL can provide AMC and maintenance support for AV systems, video conferencing, professional audio, microphones, displays, interactive panels, projectors, active LED walls, video walls, signage, automation, UPS backup, IT infrastructure and related enterprise technology systems.

faqs.question: Does GPSPL provide PAN India AMC support?
faqs.answer: Yes. GPSPL can coordinate AMC and maintenance support across India depending on site location, scope, service plan and project requirements.

faqs.question: What is the expected response time?
faqs.answer: GPSPL works with a 48-72 hour response target for AMC support, depending on location, issue type, site access, support plan and spare or OEM dependency.

faqs.question: What is included in preventive maintenance?
faqs.answer: Preventive maintenance may include inspection, health checks, source testing, cable and connectivity checks, cleaning guidance, calibration review, settings review, user workflow checks and service recommendations.

faqs.question: Does AMC include warranty support?
faqs.answer: GPSPL can coordinate eligible OEM warranty support, warranty extension guidance, spare coordination and escalation where applicable. Coverage depends on the product, warranty status and AMC terms.

faqs.question: Can GPSPL support systems not originally installed by GPSPL?
faqs.answer: GPSPL can review existing systems and define support scope after an audit. Final coverage depends on equipment condition, documentation, access, warranty status and availability of spares or OEM support.

faqs.question: Do you provide service reports?
faqs.answer: Yes. AMC can include service notes, health-check observations, recommendations, issue status and follow-up actions depending on the agreed support scope.
